sources.name: Platt
sources.uses: Every arrow on Plate I, and its literature verdict. The state names are this release's. The abundance model is its control arm.
sources.cite: Trapnell lab, University of Washington — reference v2.2.1. Cited on the project site as Duran et al., with no DOI given.
sources.frm: silver platt/README.md; counts read from the CDS this pass

sources.name: ZSCAPE
sources.modality: scRNA-seq, 1,860 individually barcoded embryos, 34 gene targets
sources.uses: The crosswalk in every state's panel, joined on shared cell barcodes, and the developmental-time distribution — 89.1% of Platt's cells are ZSCAPE cells. Its 844,825 wild-type cells are also the whole of Plate III, and its 28 perturbation targets are the arrows and the shared response axis on it.
sources.cite: Saunders, Srivatsan, Duran, Dorrity, Ewing, Linbo, Shendure, Raible, Moens, Kimelman & Trapnell. Embryo-scale reverse genetics at single-cell resolution. Nature 623 (2023).
sources.frm: silver zscape/README.md; counts read from the h5ad this pass

sources.name: ZMAP
sources.modality: harmonised meta-atlas of eight published studies
sources.uses: The ZMAP block in every state panel: an independent identity call, matched by expression profile because ZMAP shares NO cells with Platt, plus a predicted developmental age carried from its own time_id. On germ layer the two routes agree for 160 of 185 graph states. It contains neither ZSCAPE nor Platt, which is exactly what makes it an independent check rather than an echo.
sources.cite: Wagner lab, UCSF — Zebrafish Multi-study Atlas Project.
sources.frm: silver zmap/README.md; obs columns read this pass

sources.name: DanioCell
sources.scale: 489,686 cells · 149,105 in the window at 2-hour spacing
sources.uses: Nothing yet. Second independent 2-hour series across the window, and the only source carrying state persistence (how long a state lasts).
sources.cite: Sur, Wang, Capar, Margolin, Prochaska & Farrell. Single-cell analysis of shared signatures and transcriptional diversity during zebrafish development. Developmental Cell 58, 3028–3047.e12 (2023).
sources.frm: silver daniocell/README.md; obs read this pass

sources.name: Zebrahub
sources.modality: scRNA-seq, single-embryo resolution, plus light-sheet tracking
sources.scale: 120,444 cells · 12,914 at 24 hpf and 15,483 at 2 dpf
sources.uses: Nothing yet. Independent validation at both endpoints, and the only transcriptomic source already carrying ZFA ontology ids — 154 of them.
sources.cite: Lange et al. — Royer lab, CZ Biohub. A multimodal zebrafish developmental atlas reveals the state-transition dynamics of late-vertebrate pluripotent axial progenitors. Cell (2024).
sources.frm: silver zebrahub/README.md; obs read this pass

sources.name: Farnsworth
sources.uses: Nothing yet. Covers both endpoints, and its Table S2 carries a germ layer → tissue → cell type → subtype hierarchy for all 221 clusters.
sources.cite: Farnsworth, Saunders & Miller. A single-cell transcriptome atlas for zebrafish development. Developmental Biology 459(2), 100–108 (2020).
sources.frm: silver farnsworth/README.md; UCSC release read this pass

sources.name: ChemFish
sources.modality: scRNA-seq under seven single-pathway small-molecule blockades
sources.scale: 2,068,668 cells · 7 drugs + 3 vehicle arms · 36, 48 and 72 hpf
sources.uses: The whole drug layer of Plate IV. Seven pathway blockades against their matched vehicle, as compositional log fold-change per state — how a drug DEFORMS the terrain rather than moving a cell across it. Only 36 and 48 hpf fall in this window. Its cell_type vocabulary is Platt's, so it reaches the terrain through the cell-level Platt-to-ZSCAPE crosswalk.
sources.cite: Barkan et al. — Trapnell lab. Held as its authors released it; this origin overwrites in place, so two dated releases are kept.
sources.frm: silver chemfish/README.md; obs read this pass

sources.name: ZESTA
sources.uses: Nothing yet. The only spatial transcriptomics in the corpus — and it stops at 24 hpf. There is no 48 hpf spatial half to pair it with.
sources.cite: Liu, Li, Li, Lin, Zhao, Liu et al. Spatiotemporal mapping of gene expression landscapes and developmental trajectories during zebrafish embryogenesis. Developmental Cell (2022).
sources.frm: silver zesta/README.md; h5ads read this pass

sources.name: Tomo-seq
sources.modality: cryosection RNA-seq — spatial, but NOT single-cell
sources.uses: Nothing yet. The only spatial evidence at 48 hpf, and it is one organ.
sources.cite: Burkhard & Bakkers. Spatially resolved RNA-sequencing of the embryonic heart identifies a role for Wnt/β-catenin signaling in autonomic control of heart rate. eLife (2018). GEO GSE104057.
sources.frm: silver tomoseq/README.md; tar read this pass

sources.name: ZFAP
sources.uses: Nothing yet. The geometric frame — and the only source covering both endpoints of the window in three dimensions.

sources.name: ZFIN
sources.modality: ontology and curated literature records — no cells, no images
sources.scale: 3,113 ZFA terms · 2,578 overlap the window · 243,055 WT expression records
sources.uses: Nothing yet, but it defines the window: the four ZFS stages Prim-5, Prim-15, Prim-25 and High-pec ARE 24–48 hpf. It is the vocabulary every other layer would be reconciled against.
sources.cite: Zebrafish Information Network, University of Oregon.
sources.frm: silver zfin/README.md; stage_ontology.txt read this pass

sources.name: Wagner + TracerSeq
sources.uses: Nothing yet. Real clonal lineage, in the same cells as the transcriptome — and it stops exactly where this window starts.
sources.cite: Wagner, Weinreb, Collins, Briggs, Megason & Klein. Single-cell mapping of gene expression landscapes and lineage in the zebrafish embryo. Science (2018). PMID 29700229. GEO GSE112294.
sources.frm: silver wagner/README.md; tar read this pass

sources.name: LINNAEUS
sources.scale: 45 archive members · larval and adult organs
sources.uses: Nothing, and probably nothing here. Its libraries are organ codes from larval and adult regeneration; the stage needs confirming before anyone counts it as covering this window.
sources.cite: Spanjaard, Hu, Mitic, Olivares-Chauvet, Janjuha, Ninov & Junker. Simultaneous lineage tracing and cell type identification using CRISPR/Cas9 induced genetic scars. Nature Biotechnology (2018). PMID 29644996. GEO GSE106121.
sources.frm: silver linnaeus/README.md; tar listing this pass

sources.name: ITEC
sources.modality: nuclear XYZ positions and parent→child links from light-sheet tracking
sources.uses: Nothing yet, and it cannot be joined on time: the release carries FRAMES and no frame-to-hpf registration. It is the only source in the corpus that observes a division at all, which makes the missing registration the single most valuable thing to recover.
sources.cite: Wang, Zhang, Chi & Yu. Evaluation results of ITEC. Mendeley Data V1 (2025).
sources.frm: the archive itself, read this pass

sources.name: Keller
sources.modality: light-sheet nuclear positions and tracks — no transcriptome
sources.uses: Nothing yet. The physical embryo through the first day; like Wagner, it ends where this window begins.
sources.cite: Keller, Schmidt, Wittbrodt & Stelzer. Reconstruction of zebrafish early embryonic development by scanned light sheet microscopy. Science 322, 1065–1069 (2008). PMID 18845710. SSBD ssbd-repos-000005.
sources.frm: silver keller/README.md; the BDML XML read this pass
